about_the_game:
What is MCZ(Medieval Combat Zone) ? What makes it’s unique from other FPS games? Medieval Combat Zone is a First-Person Shooter(FPS) set in a Medieval Fantasy world. Modern FPS games tend to mirror the real world , MCZ based on Fantasy setting to engage players with a visually beautiful immersive world of Medieval Fantasy. Fight in a 5 vs 5 using a unique characters and Elemental Magic like, fire, water, air, and earth as a form of attack. Play a wide selection of characters, Knight, Witch, Wizard, Assassin, etc. In MCZ team is essential to win a match, however, that is not that with MCZ. Strategy is key into turning the tide of battle into your favor.

 

     Each character has their own set of unique attacks, abilities, and play style. Depending which character is selected, they will either be a melee or magic user. The variety of characters uses wands, potions, swords, knives, and bows as weapons. Every character’s weapon can be imbued with elemental magic into their weapons, each character has their own elemental magic. This allows the negation of incoming magical attacks or other weapons imbued with magic.

 

What make Medieval Combat Zone unique is the combination of clashed Elemental Magic. When two Elemental magic collide with each other, hazarders areas are created which can aid  teammates, sabotage enemies and vice versa.
